nodes.label: Client-Side Inbox Filter (channel/assignment/text)
nodes.rationale: Filtering runs in JS over data-* attributes on already-rendered rows instead of round-tripping to the server.

nodes.label: Slack App Manifest (AIOS bot)
nodes.rationale: Replaces ~10 manual clicks in api.slack.com with one import plus one install. OAuth scopes and event subscriptions live on separate pages and scopes only take effect after a reinstall, so a manifest sets both together and removes the forget-step. 'Install to Workspace' stays manual because Slack requires a logged-in human admin.

nodes.label: Version Diff View (unified + side-by-side fallback)
nodes.rationale: Backend unified diff is preferred; when unavailable the page degrades to a client-side line diff against the previous version or the current editor content.

nodes.label: One-Click Version Rollback (POST /api/agents/{id}/versions/{vid}/rollback)
nodes.rationale: Rollback never rewrites history: it copies prompt/voice/config from the chosen version into the agent and records a new version.

nodes.label: Sales Methodology Badges (BANT / SPIN / GPCT / DEF / H2H)
nodes.norm_label: sales methodology badges (bant / spin / gpct / def / h2h)
nodes.rationale: Methodology is detected by substring match on the system prompt, so badges reflect what the agent will actually do rather than a separate metadata field that could drift.

nodes.label: Voice Agent Shortcuts (SDR / Closer / Suporte)
nodes.rationale: Voice blueprints ship with a PT-BR Kokoro self-hosted voice pass at $0/min and can serve phone calls and WhatsApp on the same number.

nodes.label: Per-Type Credential Panels
nodes.rationale: Only the credential block matching the selected channel type is shown (web / slack / telegram / discord / email / voice / evolution), keeping one form usable for seven integrations.

nodes.label: Evolution Provider Selector (Baileys vs Meta Cloud API)
nodes.norm_label: evolution provider selector (baileys vs meta cloud api)

nodes.norm_label: voice provider selector (self-hosted / elevenlabs / vapi / retell / livekit)
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted Kokoro TTS/STT is the default at $0/min; without a SIP bridge calls stay queued with TTS ready and inbound arrives via /api/voice/webhook.

nodes.norm_label: internal mode nav label (uso & custos vs cobranca)

nodes.label: Budget CRUD API (/api/billing/budget)
nodes.rationale: Budgets alert at 80/90/100% but never block: block_on_exceed is informational because the operator, not the system, decides whether to keep paying.

nodes.label: Budget Burn Forecast (how long the budget lasts)
nodes.norm_label: budget burn forecast (how long the budget lasts)

nodes.label: Internal Mode Cost Control (AIOS_INTERNAL_MODE)
nodes.rationale: With AIOS_INTERNAL_MODE=true the page becomes a pure cost-control surface: plan quotas are off, nothing is billed, and the same numbers are reused for spend monitoring instead of invoicing.

nodes.label: ROI / Savings Calculator
nodes.rationale: Savings are modelled as messages x 3min x R$25/h converted at a fixed 5.5 BRL/USD reference rate; the assumptions are printed on the card so the number is not presented as a measured fact.

nodes.label: SLA Response Proxy (avg daily tokens)
nodes.rationale: Marked with an asterisk as a proxy rather than measured latency, and defers to /dashboard/analytics for real per-agent SLA.

nodes.label: WhatsApp Cloud API Recommendation Banner
nodes.rationale: Evolution/Baileys remains supported but Meta Cloud API is the recommended path because Baileys carries WhatsApp-Web ban risk.

nodes.label: Autonomous Agent Governance Loop (100% + HITL)
nodes.rationale: Autonomy is documented as Thought -> Action -> Observation -> Evaluator -> Reflection bounded by max_trials; HITL thresholds are deliberately conservative because autonomy is presented as 100% + human-in-the-loop rather than unattended.

nodes.label: Lightweight Markdown Prompt Editor
nodes.rationale: The Monaco mount point is repurposed into a custom textarea + preview pane (initLightEditor) instead of loading Monaco, keeping the page dependency-free while preserving Markdown preview, token count and Ctrl+S save.

nodes.label: Prompt Tag Structure (6 tags / 12 tags advanced)
nodes.norm_label: prompt tag structure (6 tags / 12 tags advanced)
nodes.rationale: Six base tags (ROLE, OBJETIVO, FERRAMENTAS, REGRAS, SEGURANCA, EXEMPLOS) ship by default; six advanced tags (CONTEXTO, CONHECIMENTO, FLUXO, ESTILO, FORMATO_SAIDA, VERIFICACAO) are opt-in so simple agents are not forced into a 12-section template.

nodes.label: Per-Agent-Type Prompt Templates (PROMPT_TEMPLATES)
nodes.rationale: Choosing an agent type auto-loads a domain prompt (deal_auditor, pricing_guardian, sdr, data_analyst, ...) instead of starting blank.

nodes.label: Prompt Validation (length + PT-BR language gate)
nodes.rationale: Submit is blocked for prompts under 20 or over 100k characters, and a prompt with no Portuguese/PT-BR marker requires an explicit confirmation.

nodes.label: Skills Import from URL (POST /api/skills/import-url, GET /api/skills)
nodes.rationale: Skills are pulled from GitHub raw / skills.sh / gists and become on-demand tool_patterns for the autonomous loop; import is only enabled once the agent exists, since skills are attached by agent id.

nodes.label: All Agent Blueprints Catalog (agent_templates)
nodes.rationale: The catalog renders directly from agent_templates, whose source of truth is aios/templates/__init__.py, so the page never duplicates the blueprint list.

nodes.label: Governance Blueprints - Deal Desk (5 Specialists)
nodes.rationale: Deal Auditor, Pricing Guardian, Evidence Compiler, Performance Watcher and Human Auditor are surfaced as 1-click official templates because governance is the intended entry point for core-business adoption, not custom prompt writing.

nodes.label: Proactive Alerts (GET/POST /api/analytics/proactive-alerts[/toggle])
nodes.rationale: Sales-drop detection runs on a daily 08:00 check and notifies via WhatsApp; the toggle is a notification opt-in, not a compute switch.

nodes.label: Workflow DAG Flow View

nodes.label: Visual Cron Builder
nodes.rationale: Cron is built from frequency/hour/minute/weekday controls with a live preview instead of asking users to hand-write a 5-field expression.

nodes.label: No-n8n Workflow Positioning
nodes.rationale: The product explicitly replaces n8n: webhook/cron/event triggers and a DAG of agent, HTTP, code, transform and IF steps are offered in-product with no external automation platform.

nodes.label: Performance Degradation 24h Panel
nodes.rationale: Alert thresholds are inline and explicit: errors +50% or avg_ms +15% over 7 days triggers the performance_watcher HITL agent.

nodes.label: Human vs Agent Deal Change View (CrmDealVersion)
nodes.norm_label: human vs agent deal change view (crmdealversion)
nodes.rationale: Stage skips or a 3x close_date push are treated as human-deviation signals feeding the human_auditor agent.

nodes.label: Pricing Guardian Financial Panel
nodes.rationale: Discount policy is plan-scoped (free 5%, pro 12%, enterprise 18%); exceeding it produces a Finding plus an evidence-carrying PendingAction instead of an invoice.

nodes.label: Daily Call Queue With Timing Score
nodes.norm_label: daily call queue with timing score
nodes.rationale: Timing score is computed in-house from origin + recency + attempts - explicitly 'sem provador externo' to avoid a third-party dialler dependency.

nodes.label: ARVO Immutable Financial Ledger Suite
nodes.rationale: Money is computed in Decimal, never float, and every transaction carries an EvidencePack with a digital signature - zero tolerance for duplicate or unbalanced entries.

nodes.label: Governance Blueprints (deal_auditor, pricing_guardian, evidence_compiler, performance_watcher, human_auditor)
nodes.norm_label: governance blueprints (deal_auditor, pricing_guardian, evidence_compiler, performance_watcher, human_auditor)

nodes.label: Outbox + Async Event Integration Flow (HMAC-SHA256)
nodes.rationale: Transactional integration_outbox table with 5x retry plus a 30s cron survives restart; integration_nonces (600s) and integration_events (24h TTL) give 24h dedup of retries and anti-replay.

nodes.label: Internal Tool Positioning (No Signup, No Billing)
nodes.norm_label: internal tool positioning (no signup, no billing)
nodes.rationale: Public signup is closed and plan quotas are disabled in internal mode - usage tracking continues but nothing is charged, since AIOS is a house tool, not SaaS.
